query: How many days do I have to request a 0% intro balance transfer on Apex Platinum?
gold_response: Apex Platinum cardholders have 60 days from account opening to request a 0% intro balance transfer. The intro rate lasts for 15 billing cycles, and a fee of 3% or $10 applies.

query: What is the balance transfer fee for the Everyday Freedom card?
gold_response: The balance transfer fee for Apex Everyday Freedom is 3% or $5 minimum.

query: How long does it take for an external balance transfer to process on Apex Platinum?
gold_response: Standard balance transfer requests take 5 to 7 business days to process and pay out to external card issuers.

query: How long do I have to report an unauthorized charge under the zero liability fraud policy?
gold_response: Cardholders must report unauthorized transactions within 60 days of the statement date to receive $0 liability protection.

query: What is the maximum deadline for filing a merchant chargeback dispute?
gold_response: Merchant disputes must be submitted within 120 calendar days from the original transaction date.

query: When will I receive my provisional credit during a transaction dispute?
gold_response: Provisional credit for disputed amounts over $25 is issued within 10 business days of filing.

query: Can a Tier 1 customer service agent waive the annual fee on Apex Platinum?
gold_response: Tier 1 agents cannot authorize annual fee waivers unless an active retention offer code is present in CRM. The fee is fully refundable if closed within 30 days.

query: Does the Apex Preferred Travel card charge foreign transaction fees when traveling abroad?
gold_response: No, the Apex Preferred Travel card carries a $0 foreign transaction fee on all international purchases.

query: What is the daily cutoff time for submitting payments on time?
gold_response: Payments submitted after 5:00 PM EST on the payment due date are considered late.

query: How many guest passes are included with Priority Pass Select on Apex Platinum?
gold_response: Priority Pass grants lounge access for the primary Apex Platinum cardholder plus up to 2 guests. Additional guests cost $35 per visit.

query: Do Apex Reward points expire if I keep my account active?
gold_response: Apex Rewards points do not expire as long as your account remains open and in good standing.

query: What is the deductible and coverage limit for cell phone protection on Apex Platinum?
gold_response: Coverage provides up to $800 per claim with a $50 deductible for damage or theft, limited to 2 claims per 12-month period.

query: How quickly can I receive an emergency replacement card if lost overseas on Apex Platinum?
gold_response: Emergency replacement cards can be delivered globally within 24 to 48 hours for Apex Platinum cardholders.

query: How many months must I wait before requesting a credit limit increase?
gold_response: Cardholders are eligible to request a credit limit increase after 6 months of active, on-time account history.

query: Does requesting a credit limit increase over 50% trigger a hard credit inquiry?
gold_response: Yes, hard inquiries are required for requested line increases exceeding 50% of the current credit limit, whereas soft pulls are used for standard increases.

query: What is the fee for adding authorized users to an Apex Platinum card?
gold_response: Primary cardholders may add up to 4 authorized users for $175 total per year on Apex Platinum.

query: Is there a fee for adding an authorized user on Apex Everyday Freedom?
gold_response: No, authorized users can be added to an Apex Everyday Freedom account for $0 additional fee.

query: What rental car collision insurance is provided by Apex Platinum?
gold_response: Apex Platinum provides primary auto rental collision damage waiver coverage up to $75,000 when commercial rental company waivers are declined.

query: What is the annual flight and hotel statement credit on Apex Platinum?
gold_response: Apex Platinum provides an automatic $300 statement credit per calendar year for eligible flight, hotel, and transit purchases.

query: What is the trip delay reimbursement policy threshold and amount for Apex Platinum?
gold_response: If a flight is delayed more than 6 hours or requires an overnight stay, reasonable meal and lodging expenses are covered up to $500 per ticket.

query: What foreign transaction fee applies to the Apex Everyday Freedom card?
gold_response: Apex Everyday Freedom cards incur a 3% foreign transaction fee on purchases made in foreign currencies or via non-US acquiring banks.

query: What is the cash advance APR and fee on Apex Platinum?
gold_response: The cash advance fee is 5% or $10 minimum, with a variable cash advance APR of 29.99% that begins accruing immediately.

query: Are corporate employee phones covered under Apex Business Select cell phone protection?
gold_response: Yes, coverage provides up to $1,000 per claim with a $100 deductible for business employee phones paid on the primary account, limited to 5 claims per year.

query: Can virtual card numbers be generated with custom spending limits on Apex Platinum?
gold_response: Yes, unlimited dynamic virtual card numbers can be generated via the mobile app with custom spending caps.

query: What happens if a provisional credit investigation resolves in favor of the merchant?
gold_response: If the investigation resolves in favor of the merchant, the provisional credit will be revoked with a 10-day advance notification to the cardholder.

query: What is the maximum emergency cash disbursement amount available abroad for Platinum holders?
gold_response: Emergency cash disbursements up to $1,000 USD can be arranged via Western Union within 4 hours.

query: What is the minimum credit line issued for an Apex Platinum account?
gold_response: Initial credit line assignments for Apex Platinum start at a minimum of $10,000 up to $100,000.

query: How often can I change my payment due date on Apex Everyday Freedom?
gold_response: Cardholders may change their payment due date once every 12 months via the online portal.

query: Does Apex Preferred Travel offer Global Entry or TSA PreCheck application fee credits?
gold_response: The Global Entry / TSA PreCheck credit (up to $100 every 4 years) is an exclusive benefit for Apex Platinum cardholders.

query: What is the interest grace period duration on purchase balances for Apex Platinum?
gold_response: The interest grace period is 21 days for purchase balances if the previous billing cycle balance was paid in full.
